name: NeuroFinder ZERO v1.0
description: A neural network that finds 20 classes of objects in photos

paragraphs: NeuroFinder ZERO is an experimental project created with one main goal: to prove that it is possible to design and train a full-fledged neural network for object detection completely from scratch, for free, and still get a working, positive result!

This project was not created for serious commercial or production tasks. This project is a living proof that you don't need huge budgets and corporate servers to create a working AI. This is a pure experiment, pushing the boundaries of what an ordinary developer can squeeze out of free cloud resources.
features: Completely from scratch: The network architecture does not use pre-trained weights (no ImageNet pretraining). Each conv layer was taught from scratch.
Budget — 0 rubles: The model is fully trained in the free version Google Colab on an Nvidia T4 graphics card.
Created with AI: The architecture and training pipeline are developed by the Gemini language model.
Architecture: Faster R-CNN with its custom convolutional backbone (Custom CNN Backbone) and custom Anchor Generator parameters.
